verdict: Paycor: Choose Paycor when mid-market HR+payroll with WISE AI is the job and you will take a custom quote — not when you need published SMB prices or enterprise HCM. Scores use the HR editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Full mid-market HCM (HR, payroll, talent, WFM)
bestFor: Growing US companies comparing Paycor vs Paylocity for payroll+HR
Hourly verticals (healthcare, restaurants, manufacturing) that want HCM plus scheduling
Buyers already in the Paychex orbit post-acquisition
notIdealFor: Teams that need a live published price card (Gusto)
Global EOR as the primary job (Deel — P4)
tradeoffs: Published free tiers vs paid depth for ATS, WFM, time, or training jobs
Hub / multi-module pricing complexity vs single-product floors
Mobile/frontline readiness vs desk-bound admin depth
Opaque contact-sales pricing vs transparent published seats
recommendation: Choose Paycor when mid-market HR+payroll with WISE AI is the job and you will take a custom quote — not when you need published SMB prices or enterprise HCM. Compare Paylocity for a similar modern HCM, ADP Workforce Now for payroll-compliance brand, Gusto for published SMB payroll, and Workday if enterprise HCM is the job.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS, core HRIS, payroll/benefits, people-platform, enterprise HCM, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
